prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: Empire C01-FX-02 piercing-hit animation, phase 3 DISSIPATE, one genuinely translucent residual game effect.
Primary request: Make the final fading phase of the same registered vertical puncture. Use Image 1's onset registration and simple needle geometry, reduce it to a very thin faint after-image, plus only two small dim residual chips. This must be a materially fading image with genuinely low alpha, not an opaque gray redraw.
Reference roles: Image 1 is the transparent onset and definitive geometry anchor. Image 2 is the previous peak to show the energy that is now almost gone. Image 3 original final phase specifies the faint narrow needle/two residual dark chips. Image 4 original row gives the whole motion. Do not reproduce magenta source backing.
Canvas and invariants: exactly the SAME 1254 x 1254 square transparent canvas. Conceptual pivot (627,627), central vertical axis x=627. Match Image 1's central needle endpoints and registration: top roughly (627,320), lower contact tip roughly (627,1150). In particular do NOT push the lower tip farther down or enlarge the canvas-filling extent. Keep generous fully transparent space around everything. No zoom, shift, crop, rotation, mirroring, fit or re-centering.
DISSIPATE content: the thick impact body and jagged peak side-teeth are GONE. Only one extremely slim straight pale ivory/silver needle after-image remains, no more than approximately 30 pixels wide at its widest part, from the old onset top to the fixed lower contact tip. It is intentionally faint, around 15–25% visible opacity with a delicate translucent core and fading translucent edges. Two small semitransparent charcoal/silver residual diamond chips, each around 70 x 90 pixels, remain near (470,1000) and (795,990), also much dimmer and smaller than the peak chips. At most two tiny residual dark flecks; no new energetic particles or lower slashlets.
Style and size: same broad matte value-plane language, no gradients painted as an opaque background. Keep the small after-image recognizably related to the onset needle; this ENTIRE canvas scales uniformly into 28 pixels inside a 32-pixel game cell. The final frame is held from 250ms until 420ms, so it must look like near-gone energy, not a full-strength frozen weapon.
Transparency is essential: genuine variable RGBA alpha on the faint visible remnants themselves; most pixels completely transparent, all outer perimeter pixels strict alpha=0. Semi-transparent charcoal edging is allowed but no solid black outline. Do not simulate translucency by painting solid gray onto a panel. Clean antialiasing and no colored fringes.
Avoid: opaque main body, opaque chips, actor, target body, physical spear shaft or handle, any held weapon, secondary flash, radial burst, crescent, rings, smoke cloud, haze, glow plate, ground shadow, damage numbers, text, labels, scene, checkerboard or colored backdrop. Only the very faint needle and sparse small residual chips.
